== Summary ==

== Description ==

[[Michael Raveling]], [[Anthony Lawrence]] and [[Garrett Larson]]. At the [[May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (25 May)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 25 May 2003.
